evidence.reason: The current tip already implements the requested behavior: withReapOnSettle now catches rejections, and when the thrown error is a SessionBoundError (the explicit ownership marker raised by a lane after its own onSessionCreated created the record) it reaps that fresh session id via the same reapFresh path, then rethrows the original error. Fresh-only guard (no sessionRef) and best-effort cleanup are preserved. The finding's extra proposal to rethrow on cleanup failure is not a defect in existing behavior; the original rejection/verdict is still rethrown regardless. Fixed by commit b216abcba9da101f5ccf664a2cea6e53ec2a4234 (Reap fresh sessions on pre-dispatch rejection), with the ownership-evidence rationale documented in 0a92cea5ac414988e4b181b6bc2c31e5cae33749.
